Is coercion switched off?

Source: R/problems.R
dot-strict.Rd

Is coercion switched off?

Usage

.strict()

Value

TRUE when rdantic.strict is on, using the cached value if one top-level validation is already running.

Examples

rdantic:::.strict()
#> [1] FALSE
